item.title: Upgrading
item.description:
Most releases ask nothing: a workload picks up a new library with its own next render. This page carries the ones that need a decision first.

kurly cuts a release on every push, with a calendar version that carries the time of day (library-2026.8.3141650), so an entry is dated rather than numbered and applies from the first release of that day onward.

2026-08-12 — draw-io removed, use drawio

The catalogue carried draw.io twice, as draw-io and as drawio, from the same upstream and the same image repository. draw-io is gone; drawio stays, and is the one pinned to a real version rather than to latest.
